scripts.text:
[Weird old man]
Phew, those young people nowadays, are so rude and have no manners.
scripts.translation:
[奇怪的老人]
唉，现在的年轻人，真是没大没小，毫无礼貌。

scripts.text: Ignore him
scripts.translation: 无视他

scripts.text: Talk with him
scripts.translation: 与他交谈

scripts.text:
[Weird old man]
You, very bad young man!
scripts.translation:
[奇怪的老人]
你，真是没教养的年轻人！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Sir, are you alright??
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
先生，您没事吧？

scripts.text:
[Weird old man]
....?? You are not like other young people. You have good manners! You know what happened to me..?
scripts.translation:
[奇怪的老人]
...?? 你和别的年轻人不一样。你很有礼貌！你知道我刚才发生了什么吗？

scripts.text:
[Weird old man]
I was on the way to visit my son who lives in Rune-Midgarts. It's really far away, so I took the airplane, and..
scripts.translation:
[奇怪的老人]
我本来要去卢恩·米德加兹看望住在那里的儿子。因为路途遥远，所以我坐了飞机，然后...

scripts.text:
[Weird old man]
those young people...so noisy.... I was standing but none of them offered me a seat..and they were just talking loudly which bothered everyone.
scripts.translation:
[奇怪的老人]
那些年轻人...太吵了...我站着，却没有人给我让座...而且他们大声喧哗，打扰了所有人。

scripts.text:
[Weird old man]
I could lecture them if I were 10 years younger..
scripts.translation:
[奇怪的老人]
如果我年轻十岁，我就能好好教训他们了...

scripts.text:
[Weird old man]
Pffff.. Never liked the passing of time....
scripts.translation:
[奇怪的老人]
噗...真讨厌时间的流逝...

scripts.text:
[Weird old man]
So, you... what would you do??
scripts.translation:
[奇怪的老人]
那么，你...你会怎么做？

scripts.text:
[Weird old man]
In an open, public place, you are supposed to stay quiet to the destination and offer your seat to the elderly and the infirm.
scripts.translation:
[奇怪的老人]
在公共场合，你应该保持安静直到目的地，并给老人和病人让座。

[Weird old man]
In an open, public place, you are supposed to stay quiet to the destination and offer your seat to the elderly and the infirm. Right?

难道不是吗？！

scripts.text:
[Weird old man]
Oh, and then you know what...?
scripts.translation:
[奇怪的老人]
哦，还有你知道什么吗...

scripts.text:
[Weird old man]
Once I was walking in the town and some boys were spitting on the street and were bothering girls who were passing by...tut tut!
scripts.translation:
[奇怪的老人]
有一次我在镇上散步，看到一些男孩在街上吐口水，还骚扰路过的姑娘...啧啧！

scripts.text:
[Weird old man]
The world is going to the dogs.. How will it be?? It was even day time when they were doing it..tut tut.
scripts.translation:
[奇怪的老人]
世风日下...以后会怎样？明明是大白天他们就在做这种事...啧啧。

scripts.text:
[Weird old man]
Oh, and then you know what...?
scripts.translation:

scripts.text:
[Weird old man]
Lately young people are not so patient!!!!
scripts.translation:
[奇怪的老人]
最近年轻人真是不耐烦！！！

scripts.text:
[Weird old man]
So often they say they will quit.. they say they can't do more. How will they live life with that kind of mentality..tut tut.
scripts.translation:
[奇怪的老人]
他们动不动就说要辞职...说做不下去了。带着这种心态怎么生活...啧啧。

scripts.text:
[Weird old man]
It's not easy to find a job. It is very difficult to be hired but then they even cannot stand a week there and leave the work place.
scripts.translation:
[奇怪的老人]
找工作不容易。很难被录用，但他们连一周都坚持不了就离职了。

scripts.text:
[Weird old man]
How impatient and irresponsible!!
scripts.translation:
[奇怪的老人]
真是既没耐心又没责任感！！

scripts.text:
[Weird old man]

scripts.text:
[Weird old man]
Hm......You are not like common young people, you seem pretty patient too. I like that!!!
scripts.translation:
[奇怪的老人]
嗯......你和其他年轻人不一样，看起来很有耐心。我喜欢这样！！!

scripts.text:
[Weird old man]
Now I am just an weak old man but when I was young I was a famous merchant in the town.
scripts.translation:
[奇怪的老人]
我现在只是个虚弱的老人，但年轻时我可是镇上著名的商人。

scripts.text:
[Weird old man]
It's been a while since I stopped the business,
but a former client of mine contacted me and asked me
scripts.translation:
[奇怪的老人]
虽然我很久没做生意了，
但一位老顾客联系了我，问我

scripts.text:
[Weird old man]
If I could get him some unknown objects named 'Will of Warrior', 'Thirst for Blood', and 'Chill of the Dead'.
scripts.translation:
[奇怪的老人]
能不能帮他弄到一些名为“勇士的意志”、“嗜血”和“亡者之寒”的神秘物品。

scripts.text:
[Weird old man]
I like your politeness which most young people don't have, so if you get me those, I will give you some stuff that I consider as my treasure.
scripts.translation:
[奇怪的老人]
我喜欢你这种大多数年轻人都没有的礼貌，所以如果你帮我弄到那些东西，我会给你一些我视为珍宝的东西。

scripts.text: When I gather them, I will come back
scripts.translation: 等我收集齐了，我会回来的

scripts.text: Show me the armors
scripts.translation: 给我看看防具

scripts.text: Show me the weapons
scripts.translation: 给我看看武器

scripts.text:
[Weird old man]
OK, young man. See you later.
scripts.translation:
[奇怪的老人]

箭雨风暴的攻击力增加相当于强化等级的5倍。同时该技能的SP消耗增加，若原始AGI为120，则ASPD + 1。
弓 / 攻击力 160 / 重量 90 / 武器等级 4 / 需求等级 110 / 插槽 2 / 游侠专用

scripts.text:
<<Creeper Bow[2]>>
DEX + 1, For Physical Attack, auto-cast 'Fiber Lock'(Lv 1) with a certain chance.
Bow / ATK 150 / Weight 150 / Weapon Lv 3 / Required Lv 120 / Socket 2 / for 3rd Archer Classes
scripts.translation:
<<束缚之弓[2]>>
DEX + 1, 进行物理攻击时，有一定几率自动施放“易燃之网”(Lv 1)。
弓 / 攻击力 150 / 重量 150 / 武器等级 3 / 需求等级 120 / 插槽 2 / 高级弓箭手职业专用

scripts.text: {0} Will of Warrior, {1} Thirst for Blood, {2} Chill of the Dead are needed for the exchange.
scripts.translation: 交换需要{0} 勇士的意志、{1} 嗜血渴望、{2} 亡者之寒。

scripts.text: Don't exchange
scripts.translation: 不交换

scripts.text: Exchange
scripts.translation: 兑换

scripts.text:
[Weird old man]
Okay..
scripts.translation:
[奇怪的老人]
好的。

scripts.text:
[Weird old man]
There you go. Visit me sometimes and we could talk.
scripts.translation:
[奇怪的老人]
给你。有空常来找我，我们可以聊聊。

scripts.text: ^FF0000 Check up your inventory. You got too many items to carry out the quest. ^000000
scripts.translation: ^FF0000 请检查您的物品栏。您携带的物品过多，无法继续任务。^000000

scripts.text: Umba umba humbaa
scripts.translation: 翁巴翁巴翁巴

scripts.text: What are you doing here?
scripts.translation: 你来这里做什么？

scripts.text: Which are the equipments found so far?
scripts.translation: 目前发现了哪些装备？

scripts.text: Here you are, sir.
scripts.translation: 给您，先生。

scripts.text:
[Pudding]
Hey, excuse me, but I'm not from Umbala! You are so rude.
scripts.translation:
[布丁]
喂，打扰一下，我不是汶巴拉人！你太没礼貌了。

scripts.text:
[Pudding]
As you can see I'm a training Sorcerer, and my name is Pudding.
scripts.translation:
[布丁]
如你所见，我是一名见习妖术师，我的名字叫布丁。

scripts.text:
[Pudding]
... What's that face? I'm starting to feel unpleasant..
scripts.translation:
[布丁]
... 那是什么表情？我开始觉得不舒服了...

scripts.text:
[Pudding]
A couple of days ago while I was undergoing discipline, I felt a strange, bizarre tinge. So I followed that and it brought me here.
scripts.translation:
[布丁]
几天前，我在接受训练时，感觉到一种奇怪、诡异的气息。于是我跟着它，它把我带到了这里。

scripts.text: I see.
scripts.translation: 我明白了。

scripts.text:
[Pudding]
OK, let me continue. I become bothered if you disturb me while I'm talking.
scripts.translation:
[布丁]
好了，让我继续说。我说话的时候，如果你打扰我，我会很困扰。

scripts.text:
[Pudding]
And I entered to the laboratory here in order to investigate and oh gosh! I found those monsters which were like doppelgangers from 'Geffen Dungeon'. It was full of them.
scripts.translation:
[布丁]
我进入这里的实验室进行调查，天哪！我发现了一些像“吉芬地下城”里的分身一样的魔物。那里到处都是它们。

scripts.text:
[Pudding]
From those monsters, I could find rare items like '^F2766EWill of Warrior^000000', '^952420Thirst for Blood^000000', and '^88C6F7Chill of the Dead^000000' which you cannot find in any other place.
scripts.translation:
[布丁]
从那些魔物身上，我找到了像“^F2766E勇士的意志^000000”、“^952420嗜血渴望^000000”和“^88C6F7亡者之寒^000000”这样的稀有物品，你在其他地方是找不到的。

scripts.text:
[Pudding]
And after many hours of research on my own, I finally figured out a way to use those items. Do you wanna know?
scripts.translation:
[布丁]
经过好几个小时的独自研究，我终于想出了使用这些物品的方法。你想知道吗？

scripts.text: Oh....pardon?!
Of course, I really wanna know.
scripts.translation: 当然，我真的很想知道。

scripts.text:
[Pudding]
Oh my! You fell asleep after you asked me something? Well, anyway I feel lazy to explain again so I will just continue.
scripts.translation:
[布丁]
天哪！你问完问题就睡着了？好吧，反正我懒得再解释一遍，我就继续说了。

scripts.text:
[Pudding]
Good, I am content that you are listening to my story carefully. Then I will keep explaining.
scripts.translation:
[布丁]
很好，我很满意你在认真听我讲故事。那我继续解释。

scripts.text:
[Pudding]
Those '^F2766EWill of Warrior^000000' and '^952420Thirst for Blood^000000'..... are aggressive but warm materials.
scripts.translation:
[布丁]
那些“^F2766E勇士的意志^000000”和“^952420嗜血渴望^000000”..... 是攻击性强但温暖的素材。

scripts.text:
[Pudding]
So '^F2766EWill of Warrior^000000' can dwell a special power to the 4th slot of an equipment,
scripts.translation:
[布丁]
“^F2766E勇士的意志^000000”可以将特殊能力赋予装备的第4个孔位，

scripts.text:
[Pudding]
and '^952420Thirst for Blood^000000' can dwell a special power to the 3rd slot.
scripts.translation:
[布丁]
而“^952420嗜血渴望^000000”可以将特殊能力赋予第3个孔位。

scripts.text:
[Pudding]
Whereas!!!
'^88C6F7Chill of the Dead^000000' is a cold type material
which allows the return of power from '^F2766EWill of Warrior^000000' or '^952420Thirst for Blood^000000' so makes the equipment no longer enchanted.
scripts.translation:
[布丁]
但是！！！
“^88C6F7亡者的寒意^000000”是一种冰属性素材，
它可以移除由“^F2766E勇士的意志^000000”或“^952420嗜血渴望^000000”赋予的能力，使装备不再带有附魔。

scripts.text:
[Pudding]
What do you say? Doesn't it sound interesting? But, there's a problem...
scripts.translation:
[布丁]
你觉得怎么样？听起来很有趣吧？不过，有个问题...

scripts.text:
[Pudding]
Since those materials can only be found from the monsters in the Lab., the special power also can be dwelt into certain equipments which can be obtained from the Lab.
scripts.translation:
[布丁]
因为这些素材只能从实验室的魔物身上获得，所以特殊能力也只能赋予那些在实验室中获得的特定装备。

scripts.text: So what's the conclusion?
scripts.translation: 那么结论是什么？

scripts.text:
[Pudding]
Gee.. I told you not to cut while I talk, didn't I? Well, I will answer that because that's important.
scripts.translation:
[布丁]
哎呀... 我说过让你别在我说话时打断我，不是吗？好吧，既然这很重要，我就回答你。

scripts.text:
[Pudding]
If you bring me 10 '^F2766EWill of Warrior^000000' or 10 '^952420Thirst for Blood^000000', I will dwell some power to certain equipments that you can find in the Lab..
scripts.translation:
[布丁]
如果你给我10个“^F2766E勇士的意志^000000”或10个“^952420嗜血渴望^000000”，我会将某种能力赋予你在实验室中找到的特定装备。

scripts.text:
[Pudding]
And if you are not satisfied with the power you got, bring me 10 '^88C6F7Chill of the Dead^000000', and I will take off that power.
scripts.translation:
[布丁]
如果你不满意获得的能力，就给我10个“^88C6F7亡者的寒意^000000”，我会移除那个能力。

scripts.text:
[Pudding]
What do you say? Having both options.....quite nice, huh?
scripts.translation:
[布丁]
你觉得怎么样？既有赋予又有移除... 相当不错，对吧？

scripts.text:
[Pudding]
If you obtain '^F2766EWill of Warrior^000000' or '^952420Thirst for Blood^000000', and obtain also equipment which is capable to accept their power, bring them to me. I will be waiting.
scripts.translation:
[布丁]
如果你获得了“^F2766E勇士的意志^000000”或“^952420嗜血渴望^000000”，并且也获得了能够接受其能力的装备，就带它们来找我。我会在这里等着。

scripts.text:
[Pudding]
Hm.... Equipment which are discovered so far are....
scripts.translation:
[布丁]
嗯.... 目前发现的装备有....

scripts.text:
- checking -
Pudding takes some paper out from a pocket.
scripts.translation:
- 查看 -
布丁从口袋里掏出一些纸张。

scripts.text:
[Pudding]
Let me see.. the equipments discovered until now are....
7 Armors, 14 Weapons.
scripts.translation:
[布丁]
让我看看... 目前发现的装备有....
7件防具，14件武器。

scripts.text: Ok, I don't have to know more.
scripts.translation: 好的，我不需要知道更多了。

scripts.text: 7 Armors
scripts.translation: 7件防具

scripts.text: 14 Weapons
scripts.translation: 14件武器

scripts.text:
[Pudding]
If you obtain '^F2766EWill of Warrior^000000' or '^952420Thirst for Blood^000000', and obtain also equipment which is capable to accept their power, bring them to me. I will be waiting.
scripts.translation:
[布丁]
如果你获得了“^F2766E勇士的意志^000000”或“^952420嗜血渴望^000000”，并且也获得了能够接受其能力的装备，就带它们来找我。我会在这里等着。

scripts.text:
[Pudding]
So far these are the Weapons discovered. Do you wanna see other things?
scripts.translation:
[布丁]
目前发现的武器就是这些。你想看看其他的吗？

scripts.text:
[Pudding]
Ohhhhh Have you brought them?
scripts.translation:
[布丁]
哦哦哦，你带来了？

scripts.text:
[Pudding]
OKAY! In which equipment you want to dwell the power?
scripts.translation:
[布丁]
好的！你想把力量注入哪件装备？

scripts.text: I changed my mind.
scripts.translation: 我改变主意了

scripts.text:
[Pudding]
Well, I was looking forward to doing it, but I cannot help then.
scripts.translation:
[布丁]
嗯，我本来很期待能帮上忙的，但看来帮不了你了。

scripts.text:
[Pudding]
Hey..Where is the armor?
scripts.translation:
[布丁]
嘿...你的防具呢？

scripts.text:
[Pudding]
Well.. You have nothing equipped on the left hand.
scripts.translation:
[布丁]
嗯...你左手没有装备任何东西。

scripts.text:
[Pudding]
Well.. You have nothing equipped on the right hand.
scripts.translation:
[布丁]
嗯...你右手没有装备任何东西。

scripts.text:
[Pudding]
Um.... Where's your robe?
scripts.translation:
[布丁]
唔...你的长袍呢？

scripts.text:
[Pudding]
.....Where's the accessory?
scripts.translation:
[布丁]
...饰品呢？

scripts.text:
[Pudding]
.....Where's the accessory?
scripts.translation:
[布丁]
...饰品呢？

scripts.text:
[Pudding]
Hey.. Are you not wearing any helm?
scripts.translation:
[布丁]
嘿...你没戴头盔吗？

scripts.text:
[Pudding]
First! I need to check if this equipment can accept the power.
scripts.translation:
[布丁]
首先！我需要检查这件装备是否能接受力量。

scripts.text:
[Pudding]
Hm.... This equipment cannot accept the power of '^F2766EWill of Warrior^000000' or '^952420Thirst for Blood^000000'.
scripts.translation:
[布丁]
嗯...这件装备无法接受“^F2766E勇士的意志^000000”或“^952420嗜血渴望^000000”的力量。

scripts.text:
[Pudding]
OHHH.. This equipment could accept the power of '^F2766EWill of Warrior^000000' or '^952420Thirst for Blood^000000'.
scripts.translation:
[布丁]
哦...这件装备可以接受“^F2766E勇士的意志^000000”或“^952420嗜血渴望^000000”的力量。

scripts.text:
[Pudding]
OK! Which power do you want to dwell into your equipment?
scripts.translation:
[布丁]
好！你想把哪种力量注入你的装备？

scripts.text: I say no! I don't need that!!
scripts.translation: 我说不！我不需要那个！！

scripts.text:
[Pudding]
Ohhh.. I was looking forward to doing it, but it's all up to you......
scripts.translation:
[布丁]
哦...我本来很期待能帮上忙的，但这完全由你决定......

scripts.text:
[Pudding]
Not enough '^F2766EWill of Warrior^000000'. You need to bring 10 '^F2766EWill of Warrior^000000'
scripts.translation:
[布丁]
“^F2766E勇士的意志^000000”不足。你需要带10个“^F2766E勇士的意志^000000”。

scripts.text:
[Pudding]
This equipment already has the power of '^F2766EWill of Warrior^000000'.
scripts.translation:
[布丁]
这件装备已经拥有“^F2766E勇士的意志^000000”的力量了。

scripts.text:
[Pudding]
Not enough '^952420Thirst for Blood^000000'. You need to bring 10 '^952420Thirst for Blood^000000'

[Pudding]
This equipment already has the power of '^952420Thirst for Blood^000000'.
scripts.translation:
[布丁]
这件装备已经拥有“^952420嗜血渴望^000000”的力量了。

scripts.text:
[Pudding]
Alright, which power do you want to remove?
scripts.translation:
[布丁]
好的，你想移除哪种力量？

scripts.text: No, I don't wanna remove any.
scripts.translation: 不，我不想移除任何力量。

scripts.text:
[Pudding]
Really? Ok. I got it..
scripts.translation:
[布丁]
真的吗？好吧，我明白了。

scripts.text:
[Pudding]
Not enough '^88C6F7Chill of the Dead^000000'. You need to bring 10 '^88C6F7Chill of the Dead^000000'

[Pudding]
This equipment didn't get any special power.
scripts.translation:
[布丁]
这件装备没有获得任何特殊力量。

scripts.text:
[Pudding]
The power of '^952420Thirst for Blood^000000' has been perfectly removed.
scripts.translation:
[布丁]
“^952420嗜血渴望^000000”的力量已被完美移除。

scripts.text:
[Pudding]
The power of '^F2766EWill of Warrior^000000' has been perfectly removed.
scripts.translation:
[布丁]
“^F2766E勇士的意志^000000”的力量已被完美移除。

scripts.text:
[Pudding]
Before I dwell the power, let me caution you.
scripts.translation:
[布丁]
在我赋予力量之前，我要提醒你一下。

scripts.text:
[Pudding]
While I dwell the power of '^F2766EWill of Warrior^000000' or '^952420Thirst for Blood^000000', the equipment could be not capable of accepting it and will be destroyed as a result..
scripts.translation:
[布丁]
当我赋予“^F2766E勇士的意志^000000”或“^952420嗜血渴望^000000”的力量时，装备可能无法承受，从而导致装备损毁。

scripts.text:
[Pudding]
^9D2628If the equipment is destroyed, you will also lose the cards you inserted in it, and the refine Lv will be removed too.^000000
scripts.translation:
[布丁]
^9D2628如果装备损毁，你插入其中的卡片也会丢失，强化等级也会消失。^000000

scripts.text:
[Pudding]
Alright. Do you really wish to dwell the power into the equipment?
scripts.translation:
[布丁]
好的。你真的要将力量赋予这件装备吗？

scripts.text: Wait, I will think again.
scripts.translation: 等等，我再想想。

scripts.text: Sure, carry on.
scripts.translation: 是的，请继续。

scripts.text:
[Pudding]
OK. I hope to see you again.
scripts.translation:
[布丁]
好的。期待再次见到你。

scripts.text:
[Pudding]
I hope you made the correct decision...
scripts.translation:
[布丁]
希望你做出了正确的决定...

scripts.text:
[Pudding]
...Well....the equipment could not accept the power of {0} and it got destroyed.
scripts.translation:
[布丁]
...唉...装备无法承受{0}的力量，已经损毁。

scripts.text:
[Pudding]
Fortunately, the power of {0} has been dwelt well into your equipment...
scripts.translation:
[布丁]
幸运的是，{0}的力量已成功赋予你的装备...
